full_judgment:
2. The facts relevant for disposal of the case arc that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted the Title Suit No. 170 of 1998 before the Assistant Judge, Goalando Court, Rajbari for declaration of title over land measuring an area of 1.59¼ acres as described in the schedule of the plaint. The said suit was subsequently renumbered as Title Suit No. 53 of 2001; that the land appertaining to R.S. Khatian No. 342 and R.S. Khatian No. 299 originally belonged to Chant Bala Chose as a rayat under the Jamindarship of Shatish Chandra Chakravorty which had been described in schedule-"Ka" and "Kha" of the plaint; that Charu Bala Ghose for her personal need offered to transfer the lands of both the schedules together with the other lands to the predecessor of the plaintiffs-Ahmadullah fixing the consideration at Tk. 2,000/-; that out of the total value Ahmadullah paid Tk.400/- and Gharu Bala Chose executed a deed or agreement (bainapatra) in favour of Ahmadullah on 10.02.1954; that at the request of Charu Bala Ghose, Ahmadullah subsequently paid total balance consideration to Charu Bala Ghose but she on various plea tried to linger registering the kabala; that afterwards in 1971 Chant Bala went to India as refugee and did not return; that Charu Bala was a literate lady and she along with the scribe and attesting witnesses put their signature in the bainapatra Charu Bala Ghose also executed and registered a kabala dated 24.03.1954 in respect of non suited land in which she put her signature; that plaintiffs had been possessing the suit land since their predecessor and in this way the plaintiffs acquired right and title over the suit land; that after the demise of Ahmadullah the plaintiffs inherited the land of R.S. Khatian No. 432 and 299 and had been enjoying title and possession of the suit land as per their respective shares; that on 28.05.1998 the defendant No. 1 denied the title of plaintiffs in the suit land and hence, the suit. 

 3. The defendants as heirs of Wahed Ali Mia contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the material allegations made in the plaint contending, inter alia, that father of the plaintiffs Ahmadullah during his life time got married to one Jobeda Banu, mother of the defendants. The said Jobeda Banu at first got married to one Abdul Kader and during the wedlock with Abdul Kader she gave birth one son Walled Ali (defendant No. 1) and four daughters namely 1) Sufia Banu, 2) Khairun Nessa, 3) Toubun Nessa and 4) Alia Vane; that thereafter Abdul Kader died and then Jobeda Banu got married for the 2nd time with Ahmadullah. younger brother of Abdul Kader and during the wedlock with Ahmadullah she gave birth to the plaintiff Nos. 1-2; that while Charu Bala Ghose had been in possession over the suit land of R.S. Khatian No. 432 corresponding to S.A. Khatian No. 488 offered to sell out 1.20 acres of land of S.A. Khatian No. 488 back in 44-45 years and the defendant No. 1 agreed to purchase the same fixing the consideration at Tk. 2,000/- and paid the said amount but Charu Bala did not register the Kabala at that time on various pretext; that after-wards the defendant No. 1 further paid Tk. 4,000/- to Charu Bala and then she registered kabala dated 18.06.1980 in respect of 1.20 acres of land under S.A. Khatian No. 488 and accordingly, the defendant No. 1 had been paying the rent upon mutating his name in the khatian that the claim of the plaintiffs based on false statement as well as an unregistered so-called bainapatra and as such, the suit is liable to be dismissed with cost.
